en: A monochrome street scene showing a small bridge leading into a town street lined with multi‑story buildings. People walk and cycle across the wooden bridge and along the street. On the left corner is a curved building with commercial signs at street level. On the right side of the bridge stands a post with a weight‑limit sign. Trees frame the upper right of the image. At the top of the postcard is the printed caption "Graz. Ehlergasse".
